|game_text=Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand to prevent players from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The image is the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip, which shows this text; the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-evacuationcontrol-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text, see [[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata 2)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand to prevent players from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled). (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 8, slip 121. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) and Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata; PDF by 27 August 2012) changed “may take a stacked card into hand to prevent players from drawing more than one battle destiny (those battle destiny draws may not be modified or canceled)” to “may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny)”: “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a card here into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-7; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announcement date not found). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref><ref name="cl-1220_121-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Evacuation Control (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “may take a card here into hand” to “may take a stacked card into hand”: “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=23, page 23. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=23 Internet Archive]</ref>
